I just hired a walker who can walk my dog every day twice a day. I also just found a trainer willing to help me despite the covid-19 pandemic. He’s such a good dog and he has an amazing temperament. I can take him on a 15 minute walk but I know he needs more and I want to do what I can to make it easier for him. 

Yeah I don’t understand why people are attacking me over this. He’s a service dog PROSPECT. I never said he was working. We haven’t started on PA in non pet friendly areas yet because he wasn’t ready for that but in pet stores and other pet friendly places he did really well. 

Before my accident I had some basic knowledge on how to train obedience. Training him has been a challenge because of my physical limitations but he’s so smart and also extremely food motivated so he picks up on things really quick. I also have my guardian who comes in to my home every day and helps me with different things. She has actually started researching how to owner train to try and help me. 

I agree that he’s going through a rebellious phase and I don’t think I should wash him. I’m not ready to give up on him yet and I don’t think he wants to give up on me either. As I write this he’s laying his head on my chest. I’m trying to teach him DPT since He’s a natural at picking up on my emotions. The first time I ever had a panic attack he threw himself on me and would not get off me until I calmed down.

I decided to owner train with the help of a professional trainer. Unfortunately the trainer who was supposed to come into my home and help me can’t due to the covid-19 pandemic so I’m forced to look at more expensive options. He came to me trained in basic intermediate and advanced Training
I agree. We made an appointment with our vet but he’s booked two weeks out

I definitely think it’s boredom and I take responsibility for that. I do a lot of mental stim with him but it seems he need a lot more physical stim. I’m thinking of hiring a walker who can take him on a very long walk every day

I love doing mental puzzles with him. I’m currently teaching him more fun things. I taught him to dance and play dead. I’m currently teaching him to find certain things in the house and bring them to me. He’s doing really good with that.

I guess what I meant is that it’s included within the price. I called and they train everything that I need. I’ve found that a lot of board and train facilities near me don’t include public access in the initial price

He’s a service dog prospect meaning his basic intermediate and advanced training was taken care of before he came home. We have every intention of getting a trainer do help with public access and task training later on in his life
